name: Fairchild 2N1613 planar transistor
summary: Fairchild's 2N1613, a silicon transistor made by the planar process and sold from April 1960, which brought the more reliable planar design to customers.
description: Fairchild 2N1613, NPN diffused-silicon planar transistor; not all later 2N1613 manufacturers or variants.
tier_reason: The2N1613 is a distinct product witness to a broader planar configuration, not another platform-level breakthrough. This is a scoped consequence judgement, not a reward for documentation or representation.
